reason: Clarify the browser boundary against the terminal #270 CORS contract: Runtime-provided signed artifacts may be forwarded ephemerally but are never originated, rendered, logged, cached, or persisted by Observatory.

values: Browser never becomes authority and never creates or holds private keys
Runtime-provided signed request and acknowledgement artifacts are opaque ephemeral POST inputs only and are never originated, rendered, logged, cached, or persisted by Observatory
Only Runtime status delivered is presented as delivery
Raw correlation identifiers and private authority material never render or persist
